rows.en: <operator(30090,1)><speed(2)><book(2)>Baldora Charge<endbook()><thumbnail(163)> is close to critical. <color(5)>Berkt<ce()>'s goal is about to be achieved.
rows.notes: 'goal' for mokuteki avoids the letter j (objective) per orchestrator decision.

rows.en: <operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>When the <book(3)>Wormhole<endbook()> fully opens, both worlds will be led to ruin.
<operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>But we still have a means left: the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()> can be stopped by <color(4)>Barrel<ce()><thumbnail(270)>.
rows.notes: Passive construction keeps the Baldora Drive / Barrel tag order identical to source.

rows.en: <operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>We now move to capture the area around the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()>, and attempt to stop the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()>.
<thumbdown()><operator(30090,1)><speed(2)><color(5)>Berkt<ce()> has already set up a defense. This is a full-scale battle. Go in ready for it.
<topic()><operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Everyone, there is something important I need to tell you.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>If we succeed in stopping the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()><thumbnail(162)>, the <book(3)>Wormhole<endbook()> should start shrinking and vanish before long.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Every <color(4)>Nadesico<ce()> crew member must return to our world before the <book(3)>Wormhole<endbook()> vanishes.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>The instant the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()>'s shutdown is confirmed, we will move at once to pass through the <book(3)>Wormhole<endbook()>.
<thumbdown()><operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>This is the last time we will combine our strength and fight together. I am counting on you all.
rows.notes: 'combine' for chikara wo awasete avoids the letter j (join).
